author: GitHub
description:
Before shipping new features like stacked pull requests, how does GitHub make sure nobody can break the system? In this clip from The GitHub Podcast, Senior Product Manager Sameen Karim explains how GitHub used a swarm of AI agents running around the clock to try to circumvent rules, find edge cases, and stress test code. Welcome to the era of agent-driven testing.
